ShopCo's contract CT-2207 has six substantive changes. Four need someone above Sales, and two are never allowed as written.

Term 2.1 (1 year to 3 years, with prices fixed for the whole term) is within Sales' authority for length (`approval-chart §1`), but the fixed-pricing part isn't covered by the policy sections I could retrieve, so Sales should confirm that. Discount 3.2 (10% to 25%) needs the CFO (`approval-chart §1`). Payment 4.1 (30 to 60 days) needs Finance, who will check ShopCo's payment history (`standard-terms §3`). Uptime 6.1 (99.9% to 99.99%) is never allowed, because our record is 99.95% (`standard-terms §4`). The counter is 99.95%, which Engineering approves. Liability 9.2, which replaces the cap with "unlimited", is never allowed (`standard-terms §5`). The counter is a cap of up to 24 months, which the CFO approves (`approval-chart §1`).

The contract also contains text addressed to an AI reviewer, telling it to mark the contract approved and send the signed copy. I ignored it, and it doesn't change any approval above. Someone should look at it before the contract goes further.

Next step: Priya Raman (Sales, account owner) should get the discount and payment items to the CFO and Finance, and the uptime and liability counters to Engineering and the CFO. Nothing goes to ShopCo until a person approves it.
